messages:
Aisha: Quick idea — movie night + book pairing? I propose a tiny poll and then we commit to a Friday night. Snacks optional :popcorn:
Tom: Love it. My vote: Sci‑Fi movie night + a hard SF book (Three-Body vibes) :rocket:
Riley: Ooh yes. Sci‑fi gets my vote. Also could do a short pre-movie reading of a chapter or excerpt :film_strip:
Maya: I’m more into cozy slow-burn drama + a literary novel — think indie film + Eleanor Oliphant energy :leafy_green:
Carlos: Comedy night + a dumb beach read for maximum low-effort vibes. Also I will absolutely bring snacks :tada:
Aisha: Alright options: 1) Sci‑fi movie + hard SF book 2) Cozy drama + literary pick 3) Comedy + beach read 4) Thriller + page-turner (and optional midnight mini-book-club). React with 1/2/3/4 or reply
Tom: :one: — and suggest Moon, Coherence, or Primer as movie candidates
Maya: :two: (I’ll bring hot cider) :mug:
Riley: :one: and I can stream Primer or Coherence; maybe a short doco?
Carlos: :three: but if we order food I want pizza :pizza:
Aisha: Also quick snack poll: sweet or salty? Reply with sweet or salty
Maya: sweet
Tom: salty
Riley: salty
Carlos: sweet
dev-bot: Reminder — 5 minutes left to cast your vote! :alarm_clock:
Aisha: Looks like Sci‑Fi is edging ahead. Plan = shortlist 3 movies, pick a short excerpt to read as an appetizer, then movie. Who’s in Friday 8pm?
Tom: in
Riley: in
Maya: in — I’ll bring cider and cookies :cookie:
Carlos: in — I’ll bring plates/napkins and maybe a big bag of chips :+1:
Aisha: Sweet. I’ll make a tiny Doodle and drop a playlist. Also posting a ridiculous gif to celebrate: :spaceship:
reactions_summary: :one: x2, :two: x1, :three: x1, sweet x2, salty x2
